SSC Releases Notification for 1748 Junior Engineer Posts

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of 1748 Junior Engineer (JE) posts. Applications for these positions have commenced online at ssc.gov.in. The registration fee for male candidates in the unreserved category is Rs 100, while women and candidates from reserved categories (SC, ST, PwD) are exempted from this fee. The last date to apply for the vacancies is September 22, 2026.
